acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct semi-circular notch or area of tissue loss is visible on the posterior margin of the lower (ventral) lobe of the caudal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: The distal tip of the upper caudal lobe features a concentrated area of dark pigmentation; the surface of the upper caudal lobe displays high-luminance circular spots organized into approximately four visible vertical columns.
